text:
ellen: Quick heads-up — rolling out a docs + SDK maintenance playbook this week. Core goals: keep examples up-to-date, automate linting, and provide a clear deprecation path for older SDK surface areas.

ellen: TL;DR: new docs-lint will run on PRs, we’re announcing a 6-month deprecation window for legacy sync SDK methods, and a migration guide + code-mods will be published today.

devon: Awesome — does the lint block merges or just warn?

ellen: It will warn by default for 1 week while we tune rules, then will be enforced (block) on docs PRs and sdk-example repos. We’ll add exemptions for emergency fixes.

zia: Any public notice for partners/customers?

ellen: Yes — product-ops will publish a short broadcast to partners and post a doc in the external changelog. Internal timeline and rollout plan are here: https://our-internal.docs/redwood/deprecations/sdk-sync-6mo (stub for now).

jordan: Can we get the exact lint command? want to add it to my CI.

ellen: Command: ```npx @redwood/docs-lint --fix --rules=examples,api-usage``` Add as step: `run: npx @redwood/docs-lint --ci` in GH Actions.

sam-bot: [CI] docs-lint v1.0.0 released — available in npm registry @redwood/docs-lint

maria: Migration guide — what’s covered? only sync->async, or more?

ellen: Covers sync->async rename map, updated config snippets, typical error patterns, and a small codemod repo with scripts for JS/Python examples. We’ll link code-mods from the guide and include rollout notes for Dedicated/Private docs.

devon: For the deprecation window: is it 6 months from announcement or from the doc publication?

ellen: 6 months from the public announcement date. Internal freeze for docs edits on the old APIs will start in 2 weeks; we’ll keep redirects but remove examples after 6 months.

jordan: How should authors flag docs that are intentionally using legacy examples (for historical reasons)?

ellen: Tag PRs with `docs/legacy-ok` and add a short justification in the PR body. We’ll review exceptions during the warn phase.

product-ops: We’ll draft the partner comms and put a clear timeline + migration checklist. Will ping legal for compliance language.

zia: Postmortem / rollback playbook in case migration causes regressions?

ellen: Yes — included in the maintenance playbook: emergency rollback steps, how to revert examples, and how to trigger a canary hold on the SDK distribution. Short version in the guide, full runbook under internal runbooks.

maria: Any expected breaking changes beyond method renames? quant param changes?

ellen: No breaking runtime changes planned — primarily surface/rename and improved patterns. If anything else surfaces during canary, we’ll treat as a separate deprecation with its own window.

devon: I'll add the lint step to sdk-examples and the playground repos today.

jordan: :thumbsup: will review the codemod scripts once posted.

ellen: Thanks all — publishing the migration guide + code-mods in ~1hr and sending partner note after that. If you see docs failing lint after the enforcement flip, ping #eng-infra and put `docs/urgent` on the PR.

sam-bot: [deploy] docs-site updated: /guides/migration-sync-to-async published by ellen at 1945123599

maria: ack — will update release notes.
